definition: to leave someone or something, especially someone or something that it is your responsibility to stay with
examples: He abandoned his wife and children.
The project was abandoned due to lack of funding.
Never abandon hope.

definition: to succeed in finishing something or reaching an aim, especially after a lot of work or effort
examples: She achieved her goal of becoming a doctor.
The company achieved record profits this year.
Hard work and dedication helped him achieve success.

definition: enough or satisfactory for a particular purpose
examples: The salary is adequate for my needs.
We need adequate time to prepare for the exam.
The report provides adequate information about the problem.

definition: to study or examine something in detail, in order to discover more about it
examples: Scientists are analyzing the data from the experiment.
The report analyzes the causes of climate change.
We need to analyze the situation carefully before making a decision.

definition: a helpful or good effect, or something intended to help
examples: The benefits of regular exercise are well known.
One of the main benefits of online learning is flexibility.
The new policy will bring benefits to all employees.

definition: complete and including everything that is necessary
examples: The report provides a comprehensive overview of the issue.
Students receive comprehensive training in all aspects of the job.
We need a comprehensive approach to solving this problem.

definition: to show or make something clear
examples: The study demonstrates the effectiveness of the new treatment.
She demonstrated her ability to work under pressure.
The experiment demonstrates how plants use sunlight.

definition: to give special importance or attention to something
examples: The teacher emphasized the importance of regular practice.
I must emphasize that this is a temporary solution.
The report emphasizes the need for immediate action.

definition: to make something possible or easier
examples: Technology can facilitate communication across long distances.
The new system will facilitate faster processing of applications.
The teacher's role is to facilitate learning, not just transfer knowledge.
There has been a significant improvement in air quality.
The discovery represents a significant breakthrough in cancer research.
Education plays a significant role in economic development.
